questions.question: In a psalm calling people to worship, the LORD is called a great God. What else is He called?

answers.text: A great King above all gods
A great Judge of the earth

questions.question: In a psalm of worship, God's people are said to be under His care like which animals?
A psalm of worship says that if people hear God's voice today, what must they not do?
What did God swear in His anger about the generation that tested Him at Meribah and Massah in the wilderness?

answers.text: They will never enter His rest
They will never see His face
They will never build His house
